purpose: Offline audit of retained observations, not a fresh experiment runner.
privacy_transformation: Local home-directory prefixes are replaced by /research/host; local temporary paths are minimized. Native evidence file bytes, identities, event times and outcome classifications are unchanged. HTTP byte fields are consistently re-encoded only if a location is removed. Instrument source digests are updated for the derivative copy; originals remain untouched.
source_provenance_note: ORIGINAL_PROVENANCE hashes refer to retained originals. source_sha256 below commits to each original byte sequence; export_sha256 refers to this sharing copy. These hashes provide consistency, not independent or cryptographic attestation of the original execution.
preflight_verification: Included for manual inspection; not assessed by the core matrix verifier.
excluded: earlier development runs except retained amendment descriptions
